description: Story/Gen3. The matrix's SLEEP observation. A battle inflicts sleep and the route records BOTH branches of the source's pre-turn sleep tick (bundle.deobfuscated.js:55687-55710): a `sleep_wake` (the `rng() < 0.5` branch clears the status and the turn PROCEEDS) and a `sleep_skip` (the else branch skips it). Before M4 the port modelled sleep correctly -- same 50% roll, same draw -- but logged neither, which was frozen blocker 4. Derived by a deterministic decline-everything walk over seeds 1-119 x three starters x four generations; this was the only probe in ~1400 that produced both branches, and both must be present so a mutation omitting either is killed on its own.
